sources.title: Electron security checklist
sources.excerpt: Validate the sender of all IPC messages
sources.claim: IPC caller, parsed URL origin and permissions require validation in trusted main; renderer context is not authority.
sources.limits: Guideline only; this research did not test Fabric IPC.

sources.title: Electron dialog
sources.excerpt: whether or not the dialog was canceled
sources.claim: Cancellation returns empty paths; alias resolution and MAS security-scoped bookmarks are platform-specific.
sources.limits: MAS bookmarks do not automatically apply to Developer ID distribution; picker choice still needs app grant semantics.

sources.title: Anthropic context engineering
sources.excerpt: compaction, structured note-taking, and multi-agent architectures
sources.claim: Long horizon work needs bounded relevant context, durable notes, and scoped subagents; aggressive compaction may lose later-relevant details.
sources.limits: Vendor design rationale; no measured Fabric accuracy or retention benefit.

sources.title: VS Code orphaned chat history issue
sources.claim: A contributor reports folder-URI keyed chat history orphaning on moved/renamed/deleted workspaces. Use stable Project/Run identity and explicit relink for portable Fabric context.
sources.limits: Reported feature-request, not reproduction in Fabric and not proof of all current VS Code behavior; Windows environment.

sources.title: W3C disclosure pattern
sources.excerpt: The element that shows and hides the content has role
sources.claim: Disclosure uses button activation, aria-expanded and optional aria-controls, with Enter/Space behavior.
sources.limits: APG pattern is a design baseline; keyboard/assistive-tech acceptance must run in Fabric.

sources.title: PostgreSQL LIMIT/OFFSET
sources.claim: LIMIT/OFFSET requires deterministic unique ordering; skipped rows still incur computation. Combine with local deletion-between-pages finding to design keyset cursor.
sources.limits: Docs alone do not prove snapshot isolation or no omissions under concurrent mutation; deletion race is local carryover finding.

sources.title: Node recursive readdir follows symlinks issue
sources.claim: Contributor reports recursive readdirSync traversing link outside selected tree on Node21.6.2. Use explicit lstat/no-follow traversal, realpath containment and admission-time revalidation.
sources.limits: Closed not planned; old Linux report, not current macOS Node measurement.

sources.title: Packaged macOS capture/signing issue
sources.claim: Reporter observed live getUserMedia tracks without capture samples in ad-hoc macOS builds. A capture-ready receipt must inspect actual samples and packaged signing state.
sources.limits: Closed report for ad-hoc signing; Fabric Developer ID build is not proven affected; do not copy re-sign workaround.

sources.title: Electron media permissions
sources.claim: macOS capture permission must be observed/requested with application usage descriptions; denied and restricted remain explicit states.
sources.limits: Permission status is not proof that usable samples arrived.

sources.title: Stripe engineering: idempotent APIs
sources.claim: A successful operation can lose its reply. Durable request identity plus replay/reconciliation avoids repeating effects after ambiguous completion.
sources.limits: General distributed-systems rationale, not instruction to wire Stripe into Fabric.

sources.title: Whisper model/language tradeoffs
sources.excerpt: Whisper's performance varies widely depending on the language
sources.claim: Model size, language and hardware affect accuracy/speed; published GPU figures are not target-Mac RU/EN measurements.
sources.limits: No STT choice accepted, model installed or audio uploaded by this research.

sources.title: whisper.cpp Apple Silicon support
sources.claim: Local C/C++ Whisper offers Apple Silicon and offline execution candidates; package/model size and cold/warm latency need native benchmark.
sources.limits: Repository claims only; no local install or performance claim.

sources.title: MediaRecorder stop/dataavailable semantics
sources.claim: stop delivers a final recording chunk asynchronously; record/cancel cleanup must wait or intentionally discard and prevent late transcript writes.
